script.spokenHook: Ethena dropped over 7% today while 20% of its market cap changed hands.
segmentLines: The coin fell to about $0.19, marking a decline of more than 7% in the last 24 hours.

Even with the strong downtrend, over $523 million worth of the coin was traded since yesterday afternoon.
